RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Tuesday,  the December 19, 2006/Agrahayana 28, 1928 (Saka)
————
(Ministries : Civil Aviation; Company Affairs; Culture; Finance; Heavy
Industries and Public Enterprises; Petroleum and Natural Gas;
Tourism; Water Resources)
Total number of questions — 20
Disinvestment of blue chip Public
Sector Undertakings
*381. SHRI RAMDAS AGARWAL:
Will the Minister of HEAVY INDUSTRIES
AND PUBLIC ENTERPRISES be pleased
to state:
(a) whether his Ministry has given
approval for disinvestment of 10 per cent
equity stake or so in certain blue chip Public
Sector Undertakings;
(b) if so, the details of such PSUs, name-
wise, amount-wise and State-wise;
(c) whether Government propose to
utilize funds raised through this route for
revival of other sick PSUs; and
(d) if so, the details of such sick PSUs
on Government’s list, name-wise, amount-
wise, and State-wise for the purpose of
revival till date?
Development of tourist places in
Maharashtra
*382. SHRI TARIQ ANWAR:  Will the
Minister of TOURISM be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a large number
of tourists are coming to Maharashtra;
(b) if so, the number of tourists, both
Indian and foreigners, visited the State
during the last two years; and
(c) the financial assistance provided by
the Central Government to the State
Government for the development of tourist
places in Maharashtra?
Development of Konni as major eco-
tourism project in Kerala
*383. SHRI B. J. PANDA:  Will the
Minister of  TOURISM be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is  a fact that the State
Government of Kerala has proposed to
develop Konni as a major eco-tourism
project;
(b) if so, the details thereof indicating
the outlay involved in the project;
(c) whether it is a Centrally funded
project;
(d) whether the Centre proposes to
encourage such projects in the backward
States i.e. Orissa, Jharkhand,
Chhattisgarh, Bihar etc. to improve their
economy; and
(e) if so, the details thereof?

120
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Disbursal of educational loan
*384. SHRI SUDARSHAN
AKARAPU:  Will the Minister of
FINANCE be pleased to state:
(a) the total number of loans disbursed
to students studying in rural and semi-
urban areas by Public Sector Banks during
the last three years;
(b) whether RBI has set any targets
under priority sector lending for
advancement of educational loans to rural
youth by Public Sector Banks;
(c) if so, the details thereof;
(d) if not, the reasons therefor;
(e) whether it is a fact that there is a
wide disparity between urban and rural
areas regarding disbursal of educational
loans; and
(f) what measures Government propose
to take to bridge the rural-urban divide in
this regard?
Reluctance of banks to lend to
minorities
*385. SHRI  C. PERUMAL :  Will the
Minister of  FINANCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether banks are reluctant to lend
to minorities;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor; and
(c) the steps taken to ensure adequate
credit to minorities?
Annual production of auto industry
†*386. SHRI  RAJ MOHINDER
SINGH MAJITHA:
SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
Will the Minister of  HEAVY
INDUSTRIES AND PUBLIC
ENTERPRISES be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the annual
production of the auto industry in the
country has been constantly increasing over
the years;
(b) if so, the average annual rate of
increase from the year 2000-2001 to
2005-2006; and
(c) the extent of average annual
percentage of exports achieved by the auto
industry through out of this production
during this period?
Guidelines for selection of LPG/petrol
pump outlets
*387. SHRI BHAGIRATHI MAJHI:
Will the Minister of  PETROLEUM AND
NATURAL GAS be pleased to state:
(a) whether there is any policy
guidelines for LPG and petrol pump outlet
section framed by the Ministry of
Petroleum and Natural Gas for the Dealer
Selection Board (DSB);
(b) if so, the detailed policy under which
this whole selection process takes place in
the country;
(c) whether the policy guidelines
specify all the reservations and other quotas
in the country; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Upgradation of Patna airport
†*388. SHRI MAHENDRA SAHNI:
Will the Minister of  CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are considering
to upgrade the Jai Prakash Narayan Airport
at Patna in Bihar into an international
airport;
(b) if so, the details thereof and by when;
and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?

121
Production and smuggling of narcotics
†*389. SHRI KRISHAN LAL
BALMIKI:
SHRI KALRAJ MISHRA:
Will the Minister of  FINANCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that United States
of America has included India also in the
list of countries engaged in production and
smuggling of narcotics;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government have lodged
its protest with the U.S. Government in
the said matter; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Restoration of Connemara Public
Library Building in Chennai
*390. SHRI K. P. K. KUMARAN:
Will the Minister of  CULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether the ASI has any proposal
to restore the world famous Connemara
Public Library Building, Chennai and other
places of importance in Tamil Nadu; and
(b) if so, the details thereof including
the estimated cost of projects and estimated
time for completion, project-wise?
Non-payment of statutory dues by
Cement Corporation of India
*391. SHRI M. V. MYSURA REDDY:
Will the Minister of  HEAVY INDUSTRIES
AND PUBLIC ENTERPRISES be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that budgetary
support was provided to the Cement
Corporation of India in the years 2004-05
and 2005-06 for paying statutory dues;
(b) if so, the reasons for not paying the
property tax and house tax dues of the CCI
factory situated in Yerraguntla Gram
Panchayat, Cuddapah District, Andhra
Pradesh by the Cement Corporation of
India;
(c) whether it is also a fact that CCI
diverted the funds to pay the salary
concerned dues instead of paying statutory
dues and sold the factory to India Cements
Ltd.; and
(d) by when the Cement Corporation
of India will pay the dues of Yerraguntla
Gram Panchayat?
Failure of Universal Health Insurance
Schcme
*392. SHRI S. ANBALAGAN:  Will
the Minister of  FINANCE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Universal
Health Insurance Scheme meant for health
insurance of BPL families is almost a failure;
(b) if so, the number of families/persons
insured during the last three years,
year-wise and State-wise;
(c) whether any study was conducted
for the failure of the Scheme; and
(d) if so, the details thereof and the
follow-up action proposed to be taken to
insure all the BPL families of the country
by health insurance?
Security to gas pipeline from
Myanmar
†*393. SHRI SHAHID SIDDIQUI:
Will the Minister of  PETROLEUM AND
NATURAL GAS be pleased to state:
(a) the status of gas pipeline passing
through India and Myanmar;
(b) the details of States from where this
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

pipeline would pass through and the total
expenditure to be incurred thereon; and
(c) whether attention has also been paid
on its security aspects, if so, the details
thereof?
Clearance of externally funded
Kerala Health System Project
*394. SHRI A. VIJAYARAGHAVAN:
Will the Minister of  FINANCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether the competent Authority
of Kerala has represented to the Central
Government for the clearance of Kerala
Health System Project, an externally
funded project;
(b) if so, the details of the action taken
in this regard; and
(c) whether any steps will be taken to
recommend the Project in the light of the
precarious situation prevailing in public
health?
Shortage of Indian Airlines staff at
Chennai airport
*395. SHRI B. S. GNANADESIKAN:
Will the Minister of  CIVIL  AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) the total number of Indian Airlines
staff working under various categories in
major airports viz. Delhi, Kolkata, Mumbai
and Chennai;
(b) whether Government are aware that
there is a shortage of Indian Airlines staff
in Chennai airport as compared to other
private airlines; and
(c) what plans Government have to
rectify the said shortage of Indian Airlines
staff in Chennai airport?
Facilities at IGRUA,
Rai Bareily
*396. SHRI RAJKUMAR DHOOT:
Will the Minister of  CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Indira Gandhi
Rashtriya Uran Akademi (IGRUA) Rai
Bareily is equipped with the most modern
and sophisticated trainer aircraft etc. to
impart training to pilots;
(b) if so, the details of training
curriculum and the number of pilots trained
so far;
(c) whether foreign pilots are also
availing the training facilities; and
(d) is so, the details thereof?
Implementation of river linking
project
*397. SHRI O. T. LEPCHA:
SHRI SANTOSH
BAGRODIA:
Will the Minister of  WATER
RESOURCES be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Committee of Experts
on the inter-linking of rivers has considered
the recommendations of previous Task
Force on the issue;
(b) is so, whether the Committee has
concurred with the views of the Task Force;
(c) if not, the reasons therefor and
whether Government have accepted the
views of the Expert Committee;
(d) whether the Committee has
concurred with the Task Force and if so,
what steps have been taken to implement
the river linking project; and
(e) the number of rivers which have been
identified for this project?

Restoration of Income Tax exemption
under Section 80(P) of IT Act
*398. SHRI KANJIBHAI PATEL:
SHRI JAYANTILAL BAROT:
Will the Minister of  FINANCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
the Association of Co-operative Banks in
Gujarat, some Chambers of Commerce and
Minister for Agriculture from Gujarat, have
represented to the Central Government to
restore the Income Tax exemption under
Section 80(P) of the Income Tax Act, which
has been withdrawn by the Central
Government in the current year;
(b) whether Government have
considered these representations and
rejected; and
(c) if so, the reasons therefor?
Higher duty levied on ship-breaking
industry
*399. SHRI JAYANTILAL BAROT:
SHRI SURYAKANT
ACHARYA:
Will the Minister of  FINANCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that ship breaking
industry is providing employment to a large
number of manual workers of Northern
States;
(b) whether the present rate of duty
levied on ship-breaking for the scrap metal
is higher than the duty levied on the metal
scrap in neighbouring countries particularly
Bangladesh and China;
(c) whether Government are aware that
due to this higher duty, employment is
coming down in the industry in Gujarat,
particularly at Alang;
(d) whether Government will consider
the proposal of State Government of
Gujarat to reduce the import duty to the
level of the other competitors; and
(e) if so, by when the decision with
regard to the reduction of import duty will
be taken?
Promotion of Indian Culture in
North-Eastern Region
†*400. SHRI DWIJENDRA NATH
SHARMAH:  Will the Minister of
CULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have
formulated any effective policy to protect,
develop and promote the Indian culture in
North-Eastern States;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the details of the amount spent
during the last three years for this purpose,
State-wise; and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?

RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for WRITTEN ANSWERS

and Public Enterprises; Petroleum and Natural Gas; Tourism; Water
Resources)
Total number of questions — 155
Merger of Alliance Air with Indian
2879. SHRI G. SANJEEVA REDDY:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether merger of Indian and Air
India has been already decided and the
finalisation is some what ready;
(b) if so, what about the Alliance Air
which is a subsidiary of Indian;
(c) whether Government have taken a
decision on the Alliance Air; and
(d) whether there is a plan to merge
Alliance Air with Indian?
Grounding of Airbus aircrafts
2880. SHRI PRASANTA
CHATTERJEE: Will the Minister of
CIVIL AVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) the reasons for grounding of Airbus
aircrafts;
(b) whether it is a fact that non-
availability of spares for engine are one of
the reasons for (a) above;
(c) whether it is also a fact that Indian
Airlines failed to adhere to payment
schedule for engines and spares of Airbus
aircrafts; and
(d) by when the Airbus aircrafts will be
on air?
Parking problem at Dabolim Airport
2881. SHRI SHANT ARAM
LAXMAN NAIK: Will the Minister of
CIVIL AVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether taxi owners are charged
Rs. 500/- to Rs. 1000/- per month for
parking their taxis at the Dabolim Airport;
(b) whether the Airports Authority of
India has closed access to the taxis which
were being parked in a privately owned
plot nearby the parking plot of the AAI;
(c) whether it is a fact that taxi owners
face undue harassment from the contractor
nominated to collect parking fees;
(d) whether these tussles among taxi
owners, contractors, AAI and security
personnel vitiate the pleasant atmosphere
in Goa; and
(e) if so, the details thereof?

662
New building for airport at
Ahmedabad
2882. SHRI JAYANTILAL BAROT:
SHRI SURYAKANT
ACHARYA:
SHRI KANJIBHAI PATEL:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the project
of Rs. 291 crores is prepared for the
construction of new building for
international airport at Ahmedabad and is
pending for clearance from Cabinet
Committee for Economic Affairs; and
(b) by when Government propose to
complete the project for new international
airport at Ahmedabad?
Restoration of air services from Surat
2883. SHRI JAYANTILAL BAROT:
SHRI SURYAKANT
ACHARYA:
SHRI KANJIBHAI PATEL:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that as per the
MoU signed by AAI and the State
Government of Gujarat, the project for
development of Surat airport was to be
completed by September, 2005;
(b) what are the reasons for delay in the
execution and completion of development
works of Surat airport;
(c) whether it is a fact that operation of
the civil carrier airline Air Deccan has been
stopped abruptly at the Surat airport in
July, 2005; and
(d) by when the Airports Authority of
India will restart the facility of operating
flights from Surat airport?
Opening of Karwar airport for civilian
air services
2884. SHRI JANARDHANA
POOJARY: Will the Minister of CIVIL
AVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether the State Government of
Karnataka has requested the Central
Government to open up the Karwar airport
(Sea Bird Project) to civilian flights;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether the local residents have
already contributed substantially towards
the land requirement of the Sea Bird
Project;
(d) if so, the details thereof;
(e) whether the State Government of
Karnataka has requested the Central
Government to bear the cost of acquiring
the additional 75 hectares of land required
for extending the runway and for its
construction and maintenance; and
(f) if so, the details thereof and the
Centre's response thereto?
Non-stop service between Mumbai
and New York
2885. SHRIMATI N.P. DURGA : Will
the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Air India is
going to start non-stop flights between
Mumbai and New York from next year;
(b) if so, how this move would help to
compete with Continental Airways, Delta
Airways and American Airlines which are
flying non-stop to India;
(c) whether it is a fact that the fare of
the Air India is proposed to put higher than
the abovesaid airlines; and
(d) if so, how AI will be able to corner
more and more passengers?

663
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Levy of Fuel Congestion Surcharge by
private operators
2886. SHRI DHARAM PAL
SABHARWAL: Will the Minister of CIVIL
AVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
all private domestic airlines have decided
to levy Fuel Congestion Surcharge on
passengers on account of aircraft circling
over Delhi and Mumbai airports;
(b) if so, what steps Government
propose to take on the arbitrary decision
of private airline operators imposing
uncalled for surcharge on passengers;
(c) whether it is a fact that Indian Oil
Corporation and other petroleum
companies have decided to reduce prices
of ATF on account of drop in international
crude prices; and
(d) if so, whether Government would
impress upon the private airlines to reduce
prices suo moto  in line with fall in
international ATF prices and if not, the
reasons therefor?
Security gadgets for airports
2887. SHRI M.V. MYSURA REDDY:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are planning
to introduce high technology materials for
effective security at all domestic /
international airports of the country;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the necessary steps being taken by
Government to implement the above
material at all airports; and
(d) the estimated cost likely to be
incurred on the above?
City side development of non-metro
airports
2888. SHRI EKANATH K. THAKUR:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that plans to
commercially exploit and develop the city
side area at 35 non-metro airports through
Public-Private Partnership (PPP) have hit
a roadblock as the Ministry has discovered
that not enough land is available at around
15 of these airports;
(b) whether it is also a fact that as a
result only 20 of these airports are likely
to be put up for bids for city side
developments; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
Tout menace at Delhi airport
2889. SHRI AMIR ALAM KHAN:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the menace
of touts and incidents of theft are on the
increase at the international airport in
Delhi;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) what remedial action Government
propose to take to control the situation in
this regard?
New airports in private sector
†2890. SHRI KRISHAN LAL
BALMIKI: Will the Minister of CIVIL
AVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to set
up new airports in private sector;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and

(c) whether any proposal is pending
from the State Governments in this regard?
New international airport in
Karnataka
2891. DR. M.A.M. RAMASWAMY:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have collected
any data of passenger traffic to assess the
potential of growth of passenger traffic of
international air traffic in Karnataka;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) by when the new international
airport in Karnataka is likely to be
commissioned;
(d) whether the Airports Authority of
India has drawn any plan for the usage of
the existing airport; and
(e) if so, the details thereof?
Aircrafts maintenance plant at
Nagpur
†2892. SHRI DATTA MEGHE: Will
the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the well-
known aviation company Boeing has
finalised an agreement to establish a plant
for maintenance of aircrafts in Nagpur;
(b) if so, whether initial arrangements
have been made for the establishment of
necessary subsidiary industrial units for
this plant; and
(c) by when the work of establishment
of this plant would be completed?
Offices of Registrar of Companies
2893. SHRI S.M. LALJAN BASHA:
Will the Minister of COMPANY AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Registrar of Companies has
an office at Bhubaneshwar and other place
in Orissa;
(b) how effectively does this office
protect companies and their interest;
(c) whether the Registrar reacts strongly
to ex-Directors and ex-office bearers of
companies mis-using and mis-representing
their production;
(d) whether it is a fact that office of
Registrar of Companies are generally slow
to react to misuse of offices and resulting
corruption; and
(e) the proposal to activate all
Registrars of Companies in protecting their
companies and rule of law?
Enquiry against companies involved
in share scam
2894. SHRI TAPAN KUMAR SEN:
SHRI CHITTABRATA
MAJUMDAR:
Will the Minister of COMPANY
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Serious Fraud Investigation
Office (SFIO) has sent a letter to the
Secretary, Department of Company Affairs
on 11th October, 2006 regarding
involvement of some big companies in the
activities of Ketan Parekh in the share scam;
(b) if so, the names of the companies
stated in the letter;
(c) whether any enquiry is being
conducted based on the letter; and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?

665
Composition of CCI
2895. SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:
SHRI HARISH RAWAT:
Will the Minister of COMPANY
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) what is the current composition of
the Competition Commission of India;
(b) whether it is a fact that the current
composition of the Commission is not in
accordance with the provisions of relevant
Act;
(c) if so, the reasons for such an
omission of the requirements of the Act
and for how long such a situation has been
existing; and
(d) what steps Government propose to
take to correct the situation expeditiously?
Corporate Governance
2896. SHRI JAI PARKASH
AGGARWAL: Will the Minister of
COMPANY AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Corporate Governance
has received focused attention in the recent
years world over and many countries have
amended their company laws to keep pace
with the changed world;
(b) if so, what steps Government are
taking to amend the Companies Act in a
comprehensive way;
(c) whether Government are considering
accepting the recommendations of the
much talked about JJ Irani Committee; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Budgetary support to IGNCA
2897. SHRI RAJ NATH SINGH: Will
the Minister of CULTURE be pleased to
state:
(a) the total budgetary support
extended to IGNCA;
(b) the total quantum of resources
generated by IGNCA on its own;
(c) the details of the projects being
undertaken by IGNCA;
(d) the number along with details of
employees declared surplus along the
details of the voluntary retirement schemes
offered despite these projects;
(e) the details of the plan versus non
plan expenditure of IGNCA;
(f) the details of expenditure incurred
on providing subsidized accommodation,
transport and telephone facilities to
officers, expenditure-wise, office-wise,
time period-wise for the last three years;
and
(g) the steps being taken to curtail the
non-plan expenditure?
Opening up Heritage monuments for
private purposes
2898. SHRI VIJAYKUMAR RUPANI:
Will the Minister of CULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government are
contemplating opening up Heritage
monuments for private purposes;
(b) if so, whether it will pose a danger
to the respective structure and spoil the
sanctity of the monuments;
(c) what is the amount of funds of the
Ministry have been surrendered/unutilized
during the last three years from 2003-04 to
2005-06 looking to the Budget allocations
of the respective years;
(d) whether the demands from film
world are not entertained inspite of the fact
that funds are being lapsed; and
(e) if so, the reasons therefor?

666
Recovery of Buddhist stupas in Orissa
2899. SHRI RUDRA NARAYAN
PANY:
SHRI B.J. PANDA:
MS. PRAMILA BOHIDAR:
Will the Minister of CULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that some
Buddhist stupas mentioned by the Chinese
traveller Huen Tsang have been recovered
in Orissa during excavation;
(b) whether some other valuable
material have also been recovered during
the excavations;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) what is the action plan of the Central
Government to help the State to develop
these sites with a view to boost tourism in
the State?
Protection of Cultural Heritage
Centres
†2900. SHRI JAI PARKASH
AGGARWAL: Will the Minister of
CULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) the total number of Cultural Heritage
Centres and other Heritage sites identified
as on date in Delhi and other States
alongwith locations thereof;
(b) the details of the arrangements made
by the Central and the State Governments
for their security and protection;
(c) the amount spent for this purpose
during the last three fiscal years; and
(d) the details of the proposals
submitted by the State Governments in this
regard?
Use of post offices to sell financial
products
2901. SHRI V. HANUMANTHA
RAO: Will the Minister of FINANCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have advised
banks to use post offices to sell financial
products;
(b) if so, what are the details of this
policy;
(c) what are the reasons for banks
hesitating to use the well established post
office network;
(d) the status of this concept thus for;
and
(e) the steps proposed to ask banks to
open centres in rural post offices?
Repayment of loans taken from Bank
of Rajasthan
†2902. DR. PRABHA THAKUR: Will
the Minister of FINANCE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether repayment of loans worth
crores of rupees taken during 1993 to 1998
from Bank of Rajasthan Ltd. are still
outstanding;
(b) if so, the details of the amount of
such loans and the action taken so far by
Government to recover the same alongwith
the amount recovered so far; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
Increase in direct tax collection
2903. SHRI TARIQ ANWAR: Will the
Minister of FINANCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is fact a that direct tax
collection is increased by around 50 per
cent as compared to last year;
